info.title: TaskFlow API
info.description:
Backend for the TaskFlow app: accounts, tasks, offline-first sync, settings, devices and push notifications.

Errors use RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`). Successful JSON responses are wrapped in `{ "data": ... }`.

Send `X-Device-Id: <installation id>` from the app so sync and push can tell your devices apart.

status.description: `stale`: the server has a newer version (it comes with the next pull). `rejected`: invalid, do not retry.

settings.description: Local settings in the `SettingsPatch` shape; send `updatedAt` so the newest edit wins. Invalid settings are reported as `rejected` without failing the push.

pushToken.description: FCM registration token; null to stop pushes.

localReminders.description: The client schedules reminders itself (the mobile app does).
